free_tier.stated: No service. The site serves its own upload console with 'Uploading has been disabled.'
free_tier.notes: The page also reads 'Upload servers are totally empty. 0.00%'.

retention.stated: not applicable: nothing can be uploaded; the site says 'All the links have been restored' as of 3 Jan 2023, which is the last operational statement

egress.terms: No new mirrors can be created. Whether existing aggregate links still resolve was not tested.

interface_detail: The upload console renders but the upload action is disabled by the operator.
chaining: Nothing. The working substitute is mirrored.to, which still accepts uploads and performs the same function with 40+ destinations.
binding_note: The operator has turned writes off, which is the only constraint that matters; read-side behaviour was not tested.

identity_cost.detail: Historical: registration existed at mirrorace.com/account/types. No account can be created usefully now.

reliability_note: The news table stops at 3 Aug 2023 with 'We are working on the upload speed issue. It will be fixed soon.', after two maintenance notices in the preceding eight months. No fix arrived.
confidence_note: The disabled-upload state and the empty-server counter are read from the live page. An existing mirror link would settle whether the read side still works.

evidence.proved: 'Uploading has been disabled.', 'Upload servers are totally empty.', '0.00%', and a news table whose last entry is '3 Aug 2023 ... We are working on the upload speed issue.'

notes: Two of them still work; this one does not.
